description: Trafic ferries Région Bretagne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.bretagne.bzh. This dataset contains ferry traffic figures from the ports of Roscoff and Saint-Malo. These data are extracted monthly and posted quarterly. However, corrections can be made throughout the year. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Ferry traffic Brittany Region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Ferry, Bretagne, transport, Économie, Patrimoine - Tourisme - Culture. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
